name: Conductor of Filth
body:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance class feature, Knowledge (dungeoneering) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Your familiarity with creatures of filth and corruption has granted you knowledge of how to influence them with your performances, allowing them to affect creatures of the ooze or vermin type with mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations. However, doing so requires you to expend 1 additional round of bardic performance each round you start and maintain a performance augmented by conductor of filth.

Normal: Ooze or vermin creatures are immune to your mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations.
